san-jose-evergreen.name: Tony Alexander
san-jose-evergreen.bio:
Tony Alexander joined the San José–Evergreen Community College District Board of Trustees in June 2022, representing Trustee Area 3.

He leads JW Consulting Group as president and CEO. His background includes political leadership with United Food and Commercial Workers Local 5 and service as an elected trustee and board president in the Alum Rock Union School District.

Alexander is a Senior Fellow of American Leadership Forum–Silicon Valley and a former president of the San Jose Silicon Valley NAACP. He graduated from San José City College and also attended San José State University.

Adapted from the district’s official trustee biography.
